parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary, filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL5162 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles, sorted by compound_chembl_id.
